title: Job interview, the user as the candidate
description: The user (mic) is a candidate talking to a recruiter (Leah) and a hiring manager (Tom) on the far end. Info-to-get items: team size, tech stack, remote policy, salary (answered then corrected), on-call (deflected), next steps.

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: Hi Sam, thanks for joining. I'm Leah from the recruiting team, and Tom, the hiring manager, is here too.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: Hello, nice to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Nice to meet you both. I have a few questions, if that is okay.

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: Of course, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: First, how big is the team I would be joining?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: There are eight engineers today, plus a designer and a product manager.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: And what do you build with?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: Mostly Go on the back end. The front end moved to TypeScript last year, and everything runs on Postgres.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: That sounds good. What is the policy on working from home?

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: We are hybrid. People come into the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the rest of the week is remote.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Great. Could you share the salary range for the role?

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: For this level the base is one hundred and ten to one hundred and thirty thousand.

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: Sorry, I was looking at the wrong sheet. For senior it is one hundred and twenty to one hundred and forty thousand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Thanks for checking.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: By the way, have you been to our office before? It is right next to the river.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Not yet, but I walked past it once on the way to a concert.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: How does on-call work on the team?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: Good question. It is changing next quarter, so let's leave that for the technical round.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Okay, fair enough. And what happens after today?

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: Next is a technical interview with two engineers, and then a short chat with the director.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: How long does that usually take?

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: About two weeks from start to finish.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: Do you have any questions about the product itself?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Yes. Who are your biggest customers?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: Mostly logistics companies in Europe.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Great, I think that's all from me.

utterances.speaker: Leah
utterances.text: Lovely. I'll send you the details for the technical round by email.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Thank you both, speak soon.
